evals.prompt: I've been posting on LinkedIn for 6 months. Should I start a newsletter there now?
evals.expected_output: Should say yes but flag that the timing cost is already partly paid: publishing the first edition auto-invites every existing connection and follower, a one-time event, so starting earlier would have been better. Should still recommend starting immediately. Should cite that newsletters notify every subscriber versus 8-12% feed reach and carry no external-link penalty.
assertions: Explains the one-time auto-invite of all connections
Notes the timing cost of having waited
Contrasts notification reach with 8-12% feed reach
Notes the absence of a link penalty

evals.prompt: How do I grow a newsletter from 200 subscribers?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend a referral program as the cheapest mechanic in media, citing Morning Brew going 100k to 1.7M in 18 months with ~30% of growth from referrals and CPA around $0.25. Should specify the mechanics: tiered branded physical rewards, link in every issue, visible progress. Should note Morning Brew found social and SMS referrals dwarfed email.
assertions: Specifies a referral link in every issue
Notes social and SMS outperform email referrals
